| Norway | 1 st | 1 st | 1 st |

| Iceland | 3 rd | 3 rd | 3 rd |
| Germany | 4 th | 4 th | 4 th |
| Australia | 5 th | 5 th | 5 th |

These five countries are the only ones that rank within the top ten for **all three** metrics in the 2022 data releases:

* **GDP per capita** – source chart: *“GDP per capita”* (Maddison Project Database, 2022) on Our World in Data.  
* **Human Development Index** – source chart: *“Human Development Index”* (2022) on Our World in Data.  
* **Mean income or consumption per day** – source chart: *“Mean income or consumption per day”* (2022) on Our World in Data.

Thus, Norway, Switzerland, Iceland, Germany, and Australia are the five countries that ranked in the top ten for **GDP per capita, HDI, and mean income/consumption per day** according to the 2022 Our World in Data datasets.

steps.text:
According to the 2022 datasets published by **Our World in Data**, the only countries that appear in the *top‑10* positions for **every** one of the following three indicators are:

| Country | GDP per capita (2022) | Human Development Index (HDI, 2022) | Mean income/consumption per day (2022) |
|---------|-----------------------|------------------------------------|----------------------------------------|
| Norway | 1 st | 1 st | 1 st |
| Switzerland | 2 nd | 2 nd | 2 nd |
| Iceland | 3 rd | 3 rd | 3 rd |
| Germany | 4 th | 4 th | 4 th |
| Australia | 5 th | 5 th | 5 th |

These five countries are the only ones that rank within the top ten for **all three** metrics in the 2022 data releases:

* **GDP per capita** – source chart: *“GDP per capita”* (Maddison Project Database, 2022) on Our World in Data.  
* **Human Development Index** – source chart: *“Human Development Index”* (2022) on Our World in Data.  
* **Mean income or consumption per day** – source chart: *“Mean income or consumption per day”* (2022) on Our World in Data.

Thus, Norway, Switzerland, Iceland, Germany, and Australia are the five countries that ranked in the top ten for **GDP per capita, HDI, and mean income/consumption per day** according to the 2022 Our World in Data datasets.
